definition_zh: 停止；放弃；辞职；离开；退出
definition_en: to stop doing something; to leave a job; to leave a place, in a formal older use; to close a computer program
core_image: 一张被清空的办公桌，工牌孤零零放在桌角
scene: 办公室的抽屉被清空，工牌放在桌上，她向同事点了最后一次头。After ten years she decided to quit her job and open a small bookshop.
sceneCN: 这里 quit 是「辞职、离开工作岗位」（第 2 个义项：主动离开一份工作）；句意为干了十年之后，她决定辞掉工作去开一家小书店。画面里可留意：清空的抽屉、桌上的工牌、最后一次点头。

pos.zh: 停止；放弃；辞职；离开；退出
已摆脱的；自由的（旧用法）

derivatives.zh: quit 加 -er，指轻易放弃的人
与 quit 同族的旧法律词，指债务的清偿或免除证明
re- 加同源词，指回报、酬谢或报复

senses.title: To stop doing something
senses.definition: to stop doing an activity, especially a habit
senses.definitionCN: 停止进行某项活动，尤指戒除习惯
senses.example: He quit smoking last year.
senses.exampleCN: 他去年戒了烟。
senses.why: Old French quiter meant to set free or release, and releasing a habit is the modern everyday sense of the verb.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 quiter 意为释放、解除，而把一个习惯「释放掉」正是这个动词今天最日常的用法。

senses.title: To leave a job
senses.definition: to leave a job or position, usually by your own choice
senses.definitionCN: 离开一份工作或职位，通常是主动选择
senses.example: She quit her job to travel for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 她辞了工作去旅行一年。
senses.why: If a job is a bond that holds you, quitting is leaving that bond behind, and the word came to mean resigning.
senses.whyCN: 工作像一条系住你的纽带，quit 就是离开这条纽带，于是这个词引申为辞职。

senses.title: To leave a place
senses.definition: to depart from a place, a formal or old-fashioned use
senses.definitionCN: 从某地离开，属正式或旧时用法
senses.example: The guests quit the hall before midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 客人们在午夜前离开了大厅。
senses.why: The older sense of being released from a place produced the neutral meaning of simply departing from it.
senses.whyCN: 「从某地获释」这一较早的意思，生出「单纯离开某地」这一中性含义。

senses.title: To close a program
senses.definition: to close a computer program or application
senses.definitionCN: 关闭一个计算机程序或应用
senses.example: Quit the app before you restart the machine.
senses.exampleCN: 重启机器前先退出这个应用。
senses.why: Computing borrowed a firm everyday verb for ending an activity, because a program must be told clearly to stop.
senses.whyCN: 计算机借用了这个表示「结束活动」的干脆动词，因为程序需要被明确告知停止。

intro.en: Quit came from a French verb meaning to set free, which rested on the Latin word for rest; the path from released to stopped explains its senses.
intro.cn: quit 来自一个意为「释放」的法语动词，其根基是拉丁语表示休息的词；从「被释放」到「停止」这条路径解释了它的各个义项。

items.en: Quies meant rest, and the related verb meant to bring someone or something to rest.
items.cn: quies 意为休息，相关的动词意为使某人或某物安歇下来。

items.en: Quietus meant freed from a duty or a debt, released from an obligation.
items.cn: quietus 意为从义务或债务中解脱，被免除了责任。

items.en: Quiter meant to release, to acquit, and also to leave a place.
items.cn: quiter 意为释放、免除，也指离开某地。

items.en: Middle English quit meant to pay off, to set free, and later to give up an activity.
items.cn: 中古英语的 quit 意为清偿、使自由，后来指放弃一项活动。

items.en: Modern English uses the verb for stopping habits, for resigning, for leaving and for closing a program.
items.cn: 现代英语用这个动词指戒除习惯、辞职、离开以及关闭程序。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms of the root and its near homophone; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of stopping, leaving and resigning.
note.cn: 形近组收该词根的形式与近音词；近义组收表示停止、离开与辞职的动词。

entries.definition: To a great degree or completely.
entries.definitionCN: 相当地或完全地，与 quit 拼写相近但词义不同。

entries.definition: Making little noise and staying calm.
entries.definitionCN: 声音小且保持平静。

entries.definition: A person who gives up too easily.
entries.definitionCN: 轻易放弃的人。

entries.definition: To return a favour or a wrong.
entries.definitionCN: 回报恩惠或报复伤害。

entries.definition: To end an action or a movement.
entries.definitionCN: 结束一个动作或运动。

entries.definition: To leave a job formally.
entries.definitionCN: 正式辞去工作。

entries.definition: To give up something completely.
entries.definitionCN: 彻底放弃某事物。

entries.definition: To go away from a place or a person.
entries.definitionCN: 离开一个地方或一个人。

normalIntro.en: The word began as being set free from a duty, and giving up a habit or a job is a modern version of that release.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词从「从义务中获释」开始，而戒掉习惯或辞去工作正是这种解脱的现代版本。

normal.en: Quit and quiet share a Latin root, but one means to leave a duty while the other means to stay at rest.
normal.cn: quit 与 quiet 同出一个拉丁词根，但一个指离开义务，一个指留在安静里。

normal.en: Quit smoking is the pattern for habits: the verb takes a noun ending in -ing, not an infinitive.
normal.cn: quit smoking 是戒除习惯的固定搭配：动词后面接 -ing 形式，不接不定式。

normal.en: The past tense is quit, not quitted, in everyday modern English.
normal.cn: 现代日常英语里过去式是 quit，而不是 quitted。

normal.en: A quitter is someone who quits too soon, so the derived noun carries a judgement.
normal.cn: quitter 指过早放弃的人，这个派生名词自带评价。

normal.en: Quit the app means close it deliberately, not just leave it running in the background.
normal.cn: quit the app 指主动关闭程序，而不只是让它留在后台运行。

abstract.en: Quitting is usually described as failure, yet every change of direction requires leaving something behind.
abstract.cn: 放弃通常被说成失败，但每一次改变方向都需要把某些东西留在身后。

abstract.en: To quit a habit is to decide that the person you want to be matters more than the comfort you know.
abstract.cn: 戒掉一个习惯，就是认定你想成为的那个人比熟悉的舒适更重要。

abstract.en: The word releases you from an obligation, and only you can decide whether the release is escape or freedom.
abstract.cn: 这个词把你从义务中释放，而这份释放究竟是逃避还是自由，只有你能判定。

examples.en: He quit drinking after the doctor warned him.
examples.cn: 医生警告之后，他戒了酒。

examples.en: She quit her job and moved to a smaller town.
examples.cn: 她辞了工作，搬到一座小城。

examples.en: Do not quit the program while it is saving the file.
examples.cn: 程序正在保存文件时不要退出。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「快特」——干脆利落地转身就走，记住 quit 是停止、辞职。

root: 拉丁语 quies（休息）→ quietus（获释的）→ 古法语 quiter（释放、离开）→ 英语 quit；同族有 quiet、quitter、requite。

sensesIntro.en: The core is release from a bond; the senses divide into stopping a habit, resigning a post, leaving a place and closing a program.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「从束缚中解脱」；义项分为戒除习惯、辞去职位、离开场所与关闭程序。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cleared desk with a single staff card left at its corner.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张清空的办公桌，桌角只留下一张工牌。

branches.en: a packet of cigarettes left unopened
branches.cn: 一包没拆封的香烟

branches.en: a key handed back at a front desk
branches.cn: 在前台交还的一把钥匙

branches.en: a hall emptying before midnight
branches.cn: 午夜前空下来的大厅

branches.en: a screen returning to the desktop
branches.cn: 回到桌面的屏幕

branches.en: the same release applied to a habit and to a job
branches.cn: 同一种解脱，一次用于习惯，一次用于工作

intro.en: The word comes from the Latin noun for rest and a French verb of release, with English endings that build agents and related verbs.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语表示休息的名词与法语表示释放的动词，并加上构成施动者与相关动词的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root quiet- is shared with quiet, though the two English words have parted ways in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 quiet- 与 quiet 共用，但这两个英语词在意义上已经分家。

items.meaning: a formal release of a right

definition_zh: 配额；定额；限额；（按比例分得的）份额
definition_en: a fixed share or amount assigned to a person, group or country, often acting as a limit
core_image: 一只大桶被分成若干等份，每只杯子只准取走贴着自己名字的那一份，多一滴也不行
scene: 合作社的分配会上，会计把全年的收购总量摊到各户，规定每户只能交售属于自己那一份的数量。At the cooperative meeting the accountant gave each household its quota of the yearly harvest.
sceneCN: 这里指「按规则分得的份额」，对应第 1 个义项：经事先划分后归某一方的定量；句意为会计在会上把全年收购量按户分配，每户只交售自己那一份。画面要点：分配桌、名册、等分的大桶。

pos.zh: 配额；定额；限额（可数，常与 import、sales、immigration 等连用）

derivatives.zh: 多份配额（quota 加复数后缀，语义由单份转为多份）
配额制度（quota 与 system 构成的复合词，指成套的配额安排）
配额抽样（quota 与 sampling 构成的复合术语，指按配额填格的抽样法）
以配额为基础的（quota 加 based 构成的复合形容词，指以配额为运作依据）
不受配额限制的（quota 加 free 构成的复合形容词，指免除配额约束）

senses.title: A share fixed by prior division
senses.titleCN: 事先划分后归某一方的定量
senses.definition: the part of a total that is measured out and assigned to one person or group in advance
senses.definitionCN: 总量中经事先量出并分配给某一个人或群体的那部分
senses.example: At the cooperative meeting the accountant gave each household its quota of the yearly harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 分配会上，会计把全年收购量按户分配，每户得到自己那一份。
senses.why: The Latin source is quota pars, literally 'how great a part', built on quot 'how many', so the word begins as a question about size answered by a fixed number.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语源是 quota pars，字面为「多大的一份」，由 quot「多少」构成；这个词最初就是对大小的提问，答案是一个定数。

senses.title: An official ceiling on imports
senses.titleCN: 官方设定的进口数量上限
senses.definition: a limit set by a government on the quantity of a good that may be imported
senses.definitionCN: 政府规定的某类商品可以进口的数量上限
senses.example: The government placed a quota on imported steel.
senses.exampleCN: 政府对进口钢材设定了配额。
senses.why: Once a share is fixed by authority rather than by custom, it stops being an entitlement and becomes a wall that trade cannot pass.
senses.whyCN: 当份额由官方而不是惯例来确定，它就不再是应得之份，而变成贸易越不过的一道墙。

senses.title: A required output target
senses.titleCN: 必须完成的产量或销售定额
senses.definition: the amount of work, output or sales that a worker or team is required to reach
senses.definitionCN: 要求员工或团队达到的工作量、产量或销售量
senses.example: Sales staff must meet a monthly quota before bonuses are paid.
senses.exampleCN: 销售人员必须先完成月度定额才能拿到奖金。
senses.why: The same fixed number can be read from below: what was a ceiling for imports becomes a floor that output must reach.
senses.whyCN: 同一个定数也可以从下方读：进口的上限，反过来成了产出必须够到的下限。

senses.title: A limit on the number admitted
senses.definition: the maximum number of people allowed into a country, school or programme in a period
senses.definitionCN: 在一定时期内允许进入某国、某校或某项目的最多人数
senses.example: The university keeps a quota for students from overseas.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学为海外学生保留了固定名额。
senses.why: Counting people rather than goods needs the same instrument: a number agreed beforehand keeps demand from overflowing the gate.
senses.whyCN: 数人与数货物需要同一种工具：事先商定的数字，使需求不会把门挤破。

senses.title: A fixed contribution owed by a member
senses.definition: the set portion of a common cost or supply that each member is obliged to provide
senses.definitionCN: 共同费用或物资中每一成员必须承担的那一份
senses.example: Each branch pays its quota of the association's running costs.
senses.exampleCN: 每个分会承担协会运转费用中属于自己的那一份。
senses.why: When the direction of the flow reverses, the assigned part turns into an obligation: the member owes the number instead of receiving it.
senses.whyCN: 当流向反转，被分配的那一份就变成义务：成员不再是领取这个数字，而是欠下这个数字。

senses.title: A proportional share of posts or seats
senses.titleCN: 按比例保留的席位或职位
senses.definition: a number of places reserved for a category of people in an assembly, workforce or list
senses.definitionCN: 在议会、员工队伍或名单中为某类人预留的席位数
senses.example: The party reserved a quota of seats for women candidates.
senses.exampleCN: 该党为女性候选人保留了固定比例的席位。
senses.why: Division by proportion is the oldest use of the word, and reserved seats are simply that proportion written into a rulebook.
senses.whyCN: 按比例划分是这个词最古老的用法，保留席位不过是把这一比例写进了规则手册。

senses.title: Quota sampling in research
senses.definition: a sampling method that fills each category of a population up to a preset number
senses.definitionCN: 按预设数目把总体中每一类填满的抽样方法
senses.example: The survey used quota sampling to fill each age band.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查用配额抽样填满各个年龄段。
senses.why: Statistics borrowed the word because the sample is built the way a shipment is built: each cell gets exactly its assigned count.
senses.whyCN: 统计学借用这个词，因为样本的搭建方式如同配货：每个格子里都正好放进被分配的数量。

senses.title: Any measured portion, even of non-material things
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：连非实体之物也被量出的那一份
senses.definition: an allotted amount of something abstract, such as luck, patience or misfortune
senses.definitionCN: 某种抽象之物（如运气、耐心或不幸）被分定的量
senses.example: Every generation seems to have its quota of hardship.
senses.exampleCN: 每一代人似乎都有自己那一份艰难。
senses.why: The abstract sense keeps the arithmetic but drops the goods: whatever can be counted out can also be allotted.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义保留了算术，却去掉了货物：凡能被数出来的东西，也都能被分配。

intro.en: Quota is Latin for 'how great a part'. It is the feminine of quotus 'of what number', from quot 'how many', and it entered English through legal and commercial counting. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: quota 在拉丁语中意为「多大的一份」，是 quotus「第几、若干」的阴性形式，源头为 quot「多少」；它经法律与商业的计算进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Quot was an indeclinable question word meaning 'how many', used in reckoning and in legal formulas.
items.cn: quot 是一个不变化的疑问词，意为「多少」，用于计算与法律套语。

items.en: Quotus 'of what number, which in order' supplied the adjective, and its feminine quota came to mean the part so numbered.
items.cn: quotus 意为「第几的、若干的」，提供形容词；其阴性形式 quota 后来指被这样编号的那一份。

items.en: Legal and estate records used quota pars, literally 'how great a part', for a share fixed by agreement or custom.
items.cn: 法律与田产记录用 quota pars，字面为「多大的一份」，指按协议或惯例定下的份额。

items.en: English took quota as a proportional share, first in accounts and taxation, then in any fixed allowance.
items.cn: 英语在大约 1600 年吸收 quota 表示按比例分得的份额，最初用于账目与税赋，后泛指任何固定配给。

items.en: Immigration quotas in the 1920s and import quotas in the 1930s fixed the modern sense of an official numerical limit; quota sampling followed from the same counting habit.
items.cn: 1920 年代的移民配额与 1930 年代的进口配额，确定了现代「官方数量上限」这一义；配额抽样则出自同一种计数的习惯。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin counting root but diverged in meaning; the second group offers near alternatives for the idea of an allotted amount.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语「计数」词根，但语义已分岔；第二组是「被分配的份额」这一意思的近义替代。

entries.definition: To repeat someone's words or to state a price; it comes from the same counting root but the action is marking or citing, not allotting.
entries.definitionCN: 引用他人的话或报出价格；同出「计数」词根，但动作是标出或引述，而不是分配。

entries.definition: A cited passage or a stated price; the counting root survives only in the idea of marking something down.
entries.definitionCN: 被引用的段落或报出的价格；计数词根只剩「把它标记下来」这一层。

entries.definition: The result of a division; it keeps the 'how many times' question but names an answer in arithmetic, never a share.
entries.definitionCN: 除法所得的结果；它保留「多少次」的提问，但指的是算术答案，从不指份额。

entries.definition: A fixed allowance of food or supplies, from Latin ratio 'reckoning', not from quot; it looks close but belongs to another family.
entries.definitionCN: 食物或物资的定额配给，出自拉丁语 ratio「计算」，并非 quot；形近而属于另一词族。

entries.definition: A portion belonging to one party; it states the division but not that the amount was fixed in advance by an authority.
entries.definitionCN: 属于某一方的部分；它只说划分，不说这个数量是由权威事先定下的。

entries.definition: An amount permitted to a person, often for expenses; it stresses permission rather than proportional division.
entries.definitionCN: 允许某人使用的量，常指费用；它强调许可，而不是按比例划分。

entries.definition: A maximum that may not be exceeded; it captures the limit sense of quota but not the idea of a fair share.
entries.definitionCN: 不得超过的最高限度；它涵盖配额的限额义，但不含「公平一份」的意思。

entries.definition: The process or result of assigning resources; it names the act, while quota names the measured amount.
entries.definitionCN: 分配资源的过程或结果；它指动作，而配额指被量出的数额。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real counting root, the real derived words and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「计数」词根、真实的派生词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Quot means 'how many', so quota is the answer to 'how many for you'.
normal.cn: quot 意为「多少」，quota 就是「你那份是多少」的答案。

normal.en: The same root shows in quotient and quotation, both about counting or marking a number.
normal.cn: 同一词根见于 quotient 与 quotation，两者都与计数或标号有关。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the limit sense: import quota, sales quota, immigration quota.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出限额义：进口配额、销售定额、移民配额。

normal.en: A quota is always a count, never a price: it answers how many, not how much money.
normal.cn: 配额总是数量，不是价格：它回答「多少个」，不回答「多少钱」。

normal.en: The word implies that someone has already done the splitting before you arrive.
normal.cn: 这个词隐含：在你到场之前，已经有人把总量分好了。

abstract.en: Picture a pie cut into equal wedges, each wedge tagged with a name before anyone lifts a fork.
abstract.cn: 想象一块馅饼被切成等份，每份在有人动叉之前就贴上了名字。

abstract.en: Picture a theatre with a block of seats roped off, the rope saying who may sit there.
abstract.cn: 想象剧院里有一排座位被绳子围住，绳子说明了谁可以坐。

abstract.en: Picture a queue at a gate where a counter clicks once for each person and stops at a set number.
abstract.cn: 想象门口排队，计数器每进一人跳一下，到某个数就停住。

examples.en: The fishing fleet exceeded its annual quota by two thousand tonnes.
examples.cn: 捕鱼船队超出年度配额两千吨。

examples.en: A quota on imports pushed buyers toward domestic suppliers.
examples.cn: 进口配额把买家推向国内供应商。

examples.en: She hit her sales quota three weeks before the quarter ended.
examples.cn: 她在季度结束前三周就完成了销售定额。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「括住一份」——先把总量括成若干份，你只拿写着你名字的那一份 → 配额、定额

root: 拉丁 quot「多少」→ quotus「第几、若干」→ quota（pars）「多大的一份」；英语 quota 即「按规则划出的那一份」，同根词有 quotient、quote、quotation。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all rest on one act: a total is measured out before it is used. The measured part then becomes an import ceiling, an output target, an admission cap, a member's contribution, a reserved block of seats, a sampling cell and finally any countable allotment.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都立在一个动作上：总量在被使用之前先被量出。这份量出之物随后成为进口上限、产出目标、准入人数上限、成员应缴份额、保留席位、抽样格子，最后扩展到任何可数的分配。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a barrel divided into equal parts, each cup taking only the part marked with its name.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只桶被分成等份，每只杯子只取贴着它名字的那一份。

branches.en: BASE SHARE: one measured part of a whole, assigned rather than chosen.
branches.cn: 基础份额：整体中被量出的一份，由他人指派而非自己挑选。

branches.en: LIMIT AND TARGET: the assigned number becomes a wall for imports or a floor for output.
branches.cn: 上限与目标：被指派的数量，对进口是墙，对产出是底线。

branches.en: RULES OF ENTRY: a count of people admitted, or a block of seats reserved by proportion.
branches.cn: 准入规则：限定可进入的人数，或按比例预留一批席位。

branches.en: OBLIGATION: the same number reverses direction and becomes what a member owes.
branches.cn: 义务：同一个数字反转方向，成为成员应缴的部分。

branches.en: COUNTING EXTENDED: sampling fills cells by number, and even hardship can be allotted.
branches.cn: 计数外扩：抽样按数目填格，连艰难也能被分配。

intro.en: Quota is a Latin noun built on a question word, and that question word also built several English terms about numbering.
intro.cn: quota 是由一个疑问词构成的拉丁名词，这个疑问词还构成若干英语中与计数有关的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin quot 'how many' gives quota, quotient, quote and quotation, though the last two moved from counting to marking and citing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 quot「多少」衍生 quota、quotient、quote 与 quotation，后两者已从计数转向标记与引述。

items.example: The element asks a question about quantity.
items.exampleCN: 这个成分提出的是关于数量的问题。

items.structure: quota (from quota pars, how great a part)
items.exampleCN: 每户都领到了自己那份配额。

items.example: Import quotas were raised this year.
items.exampleCN: 今年的进口配额提高了。

items.example: Divide the total by six to get the quotient.

items.structure: quote (same root, to mark or cite)
items.meaning: to repeat words or state a price
items.exampleCN: 她直接引用了那份报告。

items.meaning: a cited passage or a price offer
items.example: The quotation was valid for thirty days.
The speech had one quotable line.
items.exampleCN: 这篇演讲有一句值得引用的话。

items.meaning: a method filling categories by set counts
items.meaningCN: 按设定数目填满类别的抽样方法
items.example: Quota sampling kept the age groups balanced.
items.exampleCN: 配额抽样使各年龄组保持平衡。

latinEntries.meaning: of what number; which in order

latinEntries.structure: quota (feminine of quotus, used as a noun)

definition_zh: 引用；引述；报价；引语；报价单
definition_en: to repeat words from a text or speaker; to state a price for goods or work; words repeated from a source; a stated price
core_image: 录音笔倒回到开头，屏幕上是逐字对照的文稿
scene: 记者把录音倒回开头，逐字核对手稿里引用的那句话。The reporter checked the words she planned to quote from the interview.
sceneCN: 这里 quote 是「引用、引述」（第 1 个义项：重复别人说过或写过的话）；句意为记者核对了她准备从采访中引用的那段话。画面里可留意：倒回的录音、逐字的文稿、圈出的句子。

pos.zh: 引用；引述；报价
引语；报价单；引号（口语）

collocations.zh: 所谓（口语，表示照搬别人的说法）

quote 加 -able，指值得引用的
mis- 加 quote，指错误地引用
un- 与 quote 相对，指结束引文，多用于 quote unquote 的口语说法

senses.title: To repeat another's words
senses.definition: to repeat the exact words that someone has said or written
senses.definitionCN: 逐字重复别人说过或写过的话
senses.example: She quoted a line from the report.
senses.exampleCN: 她引用了报告里的一句话。
senses.why: The Latin verb behind the word meant to mark a passage with a number, and later to read it out with a marker, which is what citation is.
senses.whyCN: 这个词背后的拉丁语动词本指给某段落标上编号，后来指标记着朗读，这正是引用的动作。

senses.title: To state a price
senses.definition: to tell a customer in advance how much goods or work will cost
senses.definitionCN: 事先告诉顾客货物或工作要花多少钱
senses.example: The garage quoted three hundred pounds for the repair.
senses.exampleCN: 修车行对这单维修报了三百英镑。
senses.why: A merchant who marks a price on goods is marking a figure for the buyer, the same marking verb used for texts.
senses.whyCN: 商人在货物上标价，就是为买家标出一个数字，与给文本标号用的是同一个动词。

senses.title: Words repeated from a source
senses.definition: a passage repeated from a book, speech or interview, used as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 从书、演讲或采访中取来重复的一段话，作名词用
senses.example: He put a quote from the coach on the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 他把教练的一句话贴在墙上。
senses.why: English speakers shortened quotation to quote, and the shorter form kept the meaning of the cited passage.
senses.whyCN: 英语使用者把 quotation 缩略为 quote，这个较短的形式保留了「被引段落」的意思。

senses.title: A stated price
senses.definition: a price given in writing or in speech before work begins, used as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 在工作开始前以书面或口头给出的价格，作名词用
senses.example: The quote came in higher than we expected.
senses.exampleCN: 报价比我们预想的高。
senses.why: The verb to quote a price produced a noun quote for the figure itself, common in building and insurance work.
senses.whyCN: 动词「报价」产生了名词 quote，指那个价格数字本身，在建筑与保险行业很常见。

intro.en: Quote is the shortened form of quotation, and both go back to a Latin verb of numbering and marking that came to English through French.
intro.cn: quote 是 quotation 的缩略形式，两者都可追溯到拉丁语中表示编号与标记的动词，并经法语进入英语。

items.en: Quot meant how many and appeared in the numbering of chapters and lines.
items.cn: quot 意为多少，出现在给章节与诗行编号的用法中。

items.en: Quotare meant to mark a book with numbers so that a passage could be found and cited.
items.cn: quotare 意为用数字标记书本，以便找到并引证某段。

items.en: Old French quoter kept the sense of marking and citing, and also of setting a price.
items.cn: 古法语 quoter 保留了标记与引证的意思，也指定价。

items.en: Middle English used quote for citing and for stating a price, two senses that still stand side by side.
items.cn: 中古英语的 quote 既指引证，也指定价，这两层意思至今并列。

items.en: Modern English shortened quotation to quote, especially in speech, journalism and trade.
items.cn: 现代英语把 quotation 缩略为 quote，尤其在口语、新闻与商贸中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms on the Latin stem of numbering; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of citing, repeating and pricing.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语「编号」词干上的形式；近义组收表示引用、重复与定价的动词。

entries.definition: Cited words, or a price given in advance.
entries.definitionCN: 被引用的话，或预先给出的价格。

entries.definition: Worth repeating in another text.
entries.definitionCN: 值得在别的文本中重复的。

entries.definition: A fixed share assigned to a group.
entries.definitionCN: 分配给一个群体的固定份额。

entries.definition: The number produced by division.
entries.definitionCN: 除法所得的数。

entries.definition: To mention a source formally, especially in writing.
entries.definitionCN: 正式提到一个来源，尤指在写作中。

entries.definition: To say or do something again.
entries.definitionCN: 再说或再做一遍。

entries.definition: To give an approximate figure in advance.
entries.definitionCN: 预先给出约略数字。

entries.definition: To set the amount of money asked for something.
entries.definitionCN: 确定某物索要的金额。

normalIntro.en: The word marks a passage or a price: both are figures set out for others to read, repeat or accept.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词标记一段话或一个价格：两者都是摆出来供别人阅读、重复或接受的数字。

normal.en: Quote is a shortened quotation, so the noun and the verb look exactly alike.
normal.cn: quote 是 quotation 的缩略，所以名词和动词长得一模一样。

normal.en: Quote unquote is the spoken way of putting quotation marks around someone else's phrase.
normal.cn: quote unquote 是口语中给别人的说法加上引号的方式。

normal.en: A builder's quote is a price marked on paper, using the same verb as quoting a sentence.
normal.cn: 施工方的 quote 是写在纸上的价格，用的动词与引用一句话相同。

normal.en: To quote someone on a subject is to report their exact words about it.
normal.cn: quote someone on 某话题，就是报告他们对这个话题的原话。

normal.en: Misquote means to get the words wrong, and it is one of the commonest complaints in journalism.
normal.cn: misquote 意为引错话，是新闻业最常见的投诉之一。

abstract.en: To quote well is to disappear for a moment and let the other voice be heard clearly.
abstract.cn: 引得好，就是让自己暂时消失，让另一个声音被清楚地听见。

abstract.en: A price quoted in advance is a promise about the future, which is why a quote can feel like a commitment.
abstract.cn: 预先报出的价格是对未来的一个承诺，所以 quote 会让人觉得像一种约定。

abstract.en: Quoting and pricing both fix a number in place, one on a page and one on a market.
abstract.cn: 引用与定价都是把一个数字固定下来，一个固定在纸页上，一个固定在市场上。

examples.en: She quoted the contract exactly in her letter.
examples.cn: 她在信里一字不差地引用了合同。

examples.en: The shop quoted me a lower price for the same chair.
examples.cn: 同一把椅子，这家店给我报的价更低。

examples.en: He wrote the coach's quote on a card above his desk.
examples.cn: 他把教练的那句话写在一张卡片上，贴到书桌上方。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阔特」——阔气地把别人的话原样搬来，记得标出处，记住 quote 是引用。

root: 拉丁语 quot（多少）→ 中世纪拉丁语 quotare（编号、标记）→ 古法语 quoter → 英语 quote；同族有 quotation、quota、quotient。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a marked figure; the senses divide into repeating words, setting a price, the repeated words themselves and the price itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「被标出的数字或段落」；义项分为重复他人的话、定出价格、被重复的话本身，以及价格本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a recorder wound back to the start, beside a word-for-word transcript.
core.cn: 核心意象：倒回开头的录音笔，旁边放着逐字对照的文稿。

branches.en: a finger tracing one line twice
branches.cn: 手指把一行字描了两遍

branches.en: a figure written on an order form
branches.cn: 写在订单上的一个数字

branches.en: a sentence framed on a wall
branches.cn: 被框起来挂在墙上的一句话

branches.en: a sum circled at the bottom of a letter
branches.cn: 信末被圈出的金额

branches.en: the act of quoting and the thing quoted
branches.cn: 引用的动作与被引用之物

intro.en: The word is a shortened French borrowing on the Latin root of numbering, with English endings that build nouns, adjectives and negative verbs.
intro.cn: 这个词是建立在拉丁语「编号」词根上的法语缩略借词，加上构成名词、形容词与否定动词的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The stem quot- also gave quota and quotient, which keep the plain idea of a counted share.
latinIntro.cn: quot- 这个词干还给出了 quota 与 quotient，它们保留了「被计算出的份额」这一朴素意思。

definition_zh: 商；除法的结果；比率；商群、商环等代数结构；智商、情商等的简称
definition_en: the result of dividing one number by another, or a structure built by treating two things as equivalent
core_image: 一道除法竖式算完，横线上方写出一个得数
scene: 黑板上除法竖式算完，得数写在横线上方。The quotient is written above the division line after the subtraction.
sceneCN: 这里 quotient 指「除法所得的结果」（第 1 个义项：商）；句意为减法完成后，商被写在除法横线的上方。图中可辨识物件：黑板、竖式、横线、写出的得数。

pos.zh: 商；除法结果；比率；（数学结构中的）商

derivatives.zh: 商的；与商有关的
配额；定额（同出拉丁 quot「多少」）

senses.title: The result of a division
senses.definition: the number obtained when one quantity is divided by another
senses.definitionCN: 用一个量除以另一个量时得到的数
senses.example: The quotient is written above the division line after the subtraction.
senses.exampleCN: 减法完成后，商被写在除法横线的上方。
senses.why: Latin quotiens means 'how many times': the quotient answers how many times the divisor fits into the dividend.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 quotiens 意为「多少次」：商回答的就是除数在被除数里能放多少次。

senses.title: The whole-number quotient
senses.definition: the whole part of the result when a division leaves a remainder
senses.definitionCN: 除法留下余数时，结果中取整的那一部分
senses.example: Dividing seventeen by five gives a whole-number quotient of three.
senses.exampleCN: 十七除以五，整数商是三。
senses.why: everyday division asks only how many whole times the divisor fits, which is the oldest arithmetic sense.
senses.whyCN: 日常除法常常只问除数能完整放几次，这正是最古老的算术义。

senses.title: The quotient group
senses.definition: a group formed by treating elements that differ by a subgroup as equivalent
senses.definitionCN: 把相差一个子群的元素视为等价后形成的群
senses.example: The quotient group collapses the subgroup into a single identity.
senses.exampleCN: 商群把这个子群压成一个单位元。
senses.why: the construction divides the group by a subgroup, exactly as numbers are divided, so algebra reused the arithmetic name.
senses.whyCN: 这个构造用子群去「除」原群，和数被除一模一样，代数便沿用了算术的名字。

senses.title: The quotient ring
senses.definition: a ring built by declaring elements differing by an ideal to be equivalent
senses.definitionCN: 把相差一个理想的元素视为等价后形成的环
senses.example: The quotient ring has fewer elements but keeps the same operations.
senses.exampleCN: 商环的元素更少，却保留同样的运算。
senses.why: ring theory repeats the group construction with an ideal, and the same dividing name follows.
senses.whyCN: 环论用理想重复了群的构造，同一个表示「除」的名字也随之而来。

senses.title: The quotient space
senses.definition: a space formed by gluing together points that lie in the same equivalence class
senses.definitionCN: 把同属一个等价类的点粘合起来形成的空间
senses.example: The quotient space of the line by a lattice is a circle.
senses.exampleCN: 直线按一个格点群取商空间，得到一个圆。
senses.why: topology divides a space by a relation and calls the result a quotient, keeping the arithmetic metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 拓扑用一个关系去「除」一个空间，把结果称为商，保留算术的比喻。

senses.title: The intelligence quotient
senses.definition: a score comparing a person's test performance with the average for their age
senses.definitionCN: 把某人的测试表现与同龄人平均水平相比较所得的分数
senses.example: The intelligence quotient was once reported as a simple ratio of two ages.
senses.exampleCN: 智商最初被报告为两个年龄的简单比值。
senses.why: the original score was literally a quotient, mental age divided by chronological age, and the arithmetic name stuck.
senses.whyCN: 最初的分数确实是一个商，即智力年龄除以实际年龄，这个算术名字就留了下来。

senses.title: The emotional quotient
senses.definition: a measure of a person's ability to recognize and manage emotion
senses.definitionCN: 衡量一个人识别与管理情绪能力的指标
senses.example: The emotional quotient of the team rose after the training.
senses.exampleCN: 培训之后，团队的情商提高了。
senses.why: the pattern of intelligence quotient was copied for other measured capacities, so emotional quotient followed as a parallel coinage.
senses.whyCN: 智商这个模式被复制到其他可测能力上，情商便作为平行造词出现。

senses.title: The reaction quotient
senses.definition: a ratio of product concentrations to reactant concentrations at a given moment
senses.definitionCN: 某一时刻产物浓度与反应物浓度之比
senses.example: Comparing the reaction quotient with the equilibrium constant tells the direction.
senses.exampleCN: 把反应商与平衡常数相比较，就能判断反应方向。
senses.why: chemistry divides the products by the reactants, and a quotient is exactly what that division produces.
senses.whyCN: 化学把产物除以反应物，而这样除出来的正是商。

senses.title: The quotient rule in calculus
senses.definition: the rule for differentiating a function written as one expression divided by another
senses.definitionCN: 对一个写成一式除以另一式的函数求导的法则
senses.example: The quotient rule handles the derivative of one function over another.
senses.exampleCN: 商法则处理一个函数除另一个函数的导数。
senses.why: the rule is named after the quotient it differentiates, not after the result it produces.
senses.whyCN: 这条法则以它所求导的那个商命名，而不是以它产生的结果命名。

intro.en: Quotient comes from Latin quotiens 'how many times', an adverb built on quot 'how many'. It entered English through French as the name of the division result.
intro.cn: quotient 来自拉丁 quotiens「多少次」，这是由 quot「多少」构成的副词。它经法语进入英语，成为除法结果的名称。

items.en: Quot was the interrogative word for 'how many', used in counting questions; it is the seed of the whole family.
items.cn: quot 是表示「多少」的疑问词，用于计数的提问；它是整个词族的种子。

items.en: Quotiens meant 'how many times' and was used in arithmetic to introduce the result of a division.
items.cn: quotiens 意为「多少次」，在算术中用来引出除法的结果。

items.en: Medieval Latin formed the noun quotientem from the adverb, naming the number that answers 'how many times'.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语由这个副词构成名词 quotientem，命名回答「多少次」的那个数。

items.en: French quotient carried the term into English in the Middle Ages, where it settled as the standard arithmetic word.
items.cn: 法语 quotient 在中世纪把这个术语带入英语，并在那里固定为标准算术词。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries the word was extended to algebraic structures such as quotient groups, and to measured capacities such as intelligence quotient.
items.cn: 在十九、二十世纪，这个词被扩展到商群这类代数结构，也被扩展到智商这类可测能力。

items.en: The first English citation and the exact date of the medieval noun formation are approximate; quot and quotiens are securely attested.
items.cn: 英语最早书证与中世纪名词构词的确切年代都是约数；quot 与 quotiens 则有可靠记录。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin 'how many' stem and is easy to mix up; the second group names division results and related quantities.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁「多少」这个词干，容易混淆；第二组是除法结果及相关量。

entries.definition: From Latin quota pars 'what part', a fixed share assigned; it is a portion, not a division result.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 quota pars「哪一份」，指分配定的份额；是一份配额，不是除法结果。

entries.definition: From quotare 'to mark with numbers, cite', originally to number chapters; it now means to repeat words or name a price.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 quotare「标上数目、引章节」，原指给章节编号；现在指引述原话或报价。

entries.definition: The noun of quote: a cited passage or a stated price, never a result of division.
entries.definitionCN: quote 的名词：引文或报出的价格，绝不是除法结果。

entries.definition: From quotidie 'daily', built on quot plus dies 'day'; it means everyday, not divided.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 quotidie「每日」，由 quot 加 dies「日」构成；意为日常的，与除法无关。

entries.definition: A relation between two quantities; a quotient is the single number that results from dividing them.
entries.definitionCN: 指两个量之间的关系；商则是把它们相除后得到的那个单数。

entries.definition: The outcome of any operation; quotient is specific to division.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何运算的结果；quotient 专指除法。

entries.definition: The quantity being divided, the input rather than the quotient.
entries.definitionCN: 指被除的那个量，是输入而不是商。

entries.definition: The number by which the dividend is divided; the quotient is the answer.
entries.definitionCN: 指用来除的那个数；商则是答案。

entries.definition: A division written as a top and bottom number; its value equals the quotient of the two.
entries.definitionCN: 写成上下两数的除法；它的值等于两数相除的商。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin interrogative, the real family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁疑问词、真实的同族词与真实的固定搭配。

normal.en: Latin quot 'how many' plus the time-ending: the quotient answers 'how many times'.
normal.cn: 拉丁 quot「多少」加时间词尾：商回答的就是「多少次」。

normal.en: The family runs quotient, quota, quote and quotation, all from the counting stem.
normal.cn: 同族词有 quotient、quota、quote 与 quotation，都出自那个计数词干。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the modern uses: quotient group, reaction quotient, intelligence quotient.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出现代用法：商群、反应商、智商。

normal.en: A quotient is what remains after the divisor has fitted as many times as it can.
normal.cn: 商就是除数尽量放完若干次之后剩下的那个数。

normal.en: Every 'quotient' in higher mathematics is a division in disguise.
normal.cn: 高等数学里的每一个「商」，都是一次改头换面的除法。

abstract.en: Picture a box being filled by a smaller scoop, and the count of scoops is the quotient.
abstract.cn: 想象用一个小勺往箱子里装，装了多少勺就是商。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd sorted into equal rows, with the number of rows left over as the answer.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人排成等长的行，排成的行数就是答案。

abstract.en: Picture a score that compares your age with your ability, written as one number over another.
abstract.cn: 想象一个分数，把你的能力与年龄相比，写成一数除以另一数。

examples.en: The quotient of twelve divided by four is three.
examples.cn: 十二除以四的商是三。

examples.en: The reaction quotient tells which way the reaction will shift.
examples.cn: 反应商说明反应会往哪个方向移动。

examples.en: The quotient group is smaller, but its structure still reflects the original.
examples.cn: 商群更小，但它的结构仍反映原来的群。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阔申」——除完之后「阔」出来的一份 → 商

root: 拉丁 quot「多少」→ quotiens「多少次」→ 中世纪拉丁名词 quotientem → 法语 quotient → 英语 quotient。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses all answer one question: how many times does this fit into that? Arithmetic, algebra, topology, chemistry, psychology and calculus each ask it in their own way.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都在回答同一个问题：这个东西能放进那个东西几次？算术、代数、拓扑、化学、心理学与微积分各用自己的方式发问。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long division finished, with one number written above the line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道除法竖式算完，横线上方写着一个数。

branches.en: THE ANSWER AND THE WHOLE PART: the division result, and the integer left when a remainder remains.
branches.cn: 答案与整数部分：除法的结果，以及留下余数时取整的那一段。

branches.en: STRUCTURES BY DIVISION: groups, rings and spaces are all built by treating a substructure as nothing.
branches.cn: 用除法造结构：群、环与空间都是靠把一个子结构当作「无」来构造。

branches.en: MEASURED MIND: intelligence and emotion are both scored as a ratio against an average.
branches.cn: 被量化的心智：智商与情商都被写成相对于平均值的比值。

branches.en: CHEMICAL RATIO: products divided by reactants at a chosen moment.
branches.cn: 化学比值：在某一时刻把产物除以反应物。

branches.en: RULE FOR A RATIO: the derivative rule named after the quotient it handles.
branches.cn: 处理商的法则：以它所处理的那个商命名的求导法则。

intro.en: Quotient is built from a Latin question word and a noun ending; the same question word also built quota and quote.
intro.cn: quotient 由一个拉丁疑问词与一个名词词尾构成；同一个疑问词还造出了 quota 与 quote。

latinIntro.en: Latin quot 'how many' gives quotiens 'how many times', quota 'what part', and quotare 'to number'; the English family keeps the counting idea throughout.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 quot「多少」衍生 quotiens「多少次」、quota「哪一份」与 quotare「编号」；英语词族始终保留计数的意思。

items.example: The question word starts the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个疑问词开启了整个词族。

items.example: The adverb asks the division question directly.
items.exampleCN: 这个副词直接提出了除法的问题。

items.structure: quotiens used as a noun (Medieval Latin)
items.example: The medieval noun named the arithmetic answer.
items.exampleCN: 这个中世纪名词命名了算术答案。

items.meaning: to cite or state a price
a cited passage; a price offered
items.example: The quotation came to a fair price.
items.exampleCN: 报价开出了一个公道价。

items.example: The quotiental form of the map is compact.
items.exampleCN: 该映射的商形式是紧的。

derivatives.zh: 商的；与商有关的
配额；定额（同出拉丁 quot）
引用；报价（同出拉丁 quotare）
引文；报价（同出 quotare）

definition_zh: 赛跑；竞赛；种族；急奔；（磨坊）水道
definition_en: a competition to see who is fastest; a contest between people or groups; a group of people sharing ancestry; to move very fast; a channel of water leading to a mill
core_image: 傍晚的跑道上，几名选手同时冲过起跑线
scene: 傍晚的跑道上，发令枪响后几名选手同时冲出起跑线。He won the final race by less than a second.
sceneCN: 这里 race 是「赛跑、竞速比赛」（第 1 个义项：比谁跑得快的比赛）；句意为他以不到一秒的优势赢下了最后一场比赛。画面里可留意：起点线、发令枪、几乎并排的身影。

pos.zh: 赛跑；竞赛；种族；（磨坊）水道
急速行进；参赛；使拼命跑

derivatives.zh: race 加 -er，指参赛者或赛车
race 加 -ing，指赛跑、赛车等竞技活动
race 加 -ial，指与种族有关的
race 加 -ist，指持种族歧视观点的

senses.title: A competition of speed
senses.definition: a contest to find who or what is fastest
senses.definitionCN: 比出谁或什么最快的一种竞赛
senses.example: He won the hundred-metre race.
senses.exampleCN: 他赢下了百米赛跑。
senses.why: The contest sense comes from an old northern word for a rush or a run, so the word began as the movement itself.
senses.whyCN: 比赛义来自一个古老的北方词，意为「急冲、奔跑」，所以这个词最初指的就是那股奔跑。

senses.title: A contest between people or groups
senses.definition: a situation in which people or groups try to be first to reach a goal
senses.definitionCN: 人或群体争相抢先达到某个目标的情形
senses.example: The race for the contract ended in a tie.
senses.exampleCN: 争取这份合同的竞争以平局收场。
senses.why: Once a race was a run toward a line, any struggle to arrive first could be called a race, even without running.
senses.whyCN: 当 race 指朝终点线奔跑之后，任何「抢在前头」的争夺都可以叫 race，即使根本不用跑。

senses.title: A group sharing ancestry
senses.definition: a group of people regarded as sharing ancestry and physical features, a term used with care
senses.definitionCN: 被视为共享血统与外貌特征的一群人，此词使用时须谨慎
senses.example: People of every race took part in the survey.
senses.exampleCN: 各种族的人都参加了这项调查。
senses.why: This sense comes from a different source, an Italian word for kind or breed, and its scientific status has been much debated.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项来源不同，出自一个意为「种类、品种」的意大利语词，其科学地位一直备受争议。

senses.title: To move very fast
senses.definition: to move at great speed, often in a hurry or in competition
senses.definitionCN: 以很快的速度移动，常带匆忙或竞争意味
senses.example: She raced to catch the last bus.
senses.exampleCN: 她飞奔去赶末班车。
senses.why: Since the word first named a rush, the verb simply describes the act of rushing, with or without a contest.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个词最初指一股急冲，动词就只是描述急冲这一动作，无论有没有比赛。

senses.title: A channel of water
senses.definition: a fast current of water, especially one made to drive a mill wheel
senses.definitionCN: 流速较快的水道，尤指为驱动磨坊水轮而开的渠道
senses.example: The old mill still stands beside the race.
senses.exampleCN: 那座老磨坊仍然立在水道旁边。
senses.why: Water rushing through a narrow channel moves like a runner, so the old sense of a rush survived in the mill race.
senses.whyCN: 水冲过窄渠时像奔跑者一样急行，于是「急冲」这一古老意思在磨坊水道里保留下来。

intro.en: Race is really two words: the contest sense comes from an old northern word for a rush, while the ancestry sense comes through French and Italian from a word of uncertain origin.
intro.cn: race 实际上是两个词：比赛义来自古老的北方词「急冲」，而种族义经法语与意大利语来自一个来源不确定的词。

items.en: Ras meant a running or a rush, and it entered northern English with the sense of swift movement.
items.cn: ras 意为奔跑、急冲，带着快速运动的意思进入英格兰北部英语。

items.en: Middle English race named a run or a course, and from that a contest of speed.
items.cn: 中古英语的 race 指一次奔跑或一段跑道，由此生出速度竞赛之义。

items.en: A separate French word razza, of uncertain origin, meant a breed or a kind, especially of animals.
items.cn: 另一个来源不确定的法语词 razza 意为品种或种类，尤指动物的品种。

items.en: English applied the breed sense to groups of people, a use that later became scientifically and socially disputed.
items.cn: 英语把「品种」义用到人群上，这一用法后来在科学与社会层面都引发争议。

items.en: Modern English keeps both words: race as a contest and race as a category of people, plus the mill race of flowing water.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了两个词：作为竞赛的 race、作为人群类别的 race，以及指流水渠道的磨坊 race。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the word; the near-meaning group gathers words for contests, speed and ancestry.
note.cn: 形近组收由这个词构成的形式；近义组收表示竞赛、速度与血统的词。

entries.definition: A person or vehicle that takes part in races.
entries.definitionCN: 参加比赛的人或车辆。

entries.definition: The sport of competing for speed.
entries.definitionCN: 比速度的竞技运动。

entries.definition: Connected with a group sharing ancestry.
entries.definitionCN: 与共享血统的群体有关的。

entries.definition: Someone who treats people unequally because of their group.
entries.definitionCN: 因所属群体而区别对待他人的人。

entries.definition: A competition in which people try to win.
entries.definitionCN: 人们争胜的比赛。

entries.definition: The activity of trying to do better than others.
entries.definitionCN: 力图胜过他人的活动。

entries.definition: To run at top speed for a short distance.
entries.definitionCN: 短距离全速奔跑。

entries.definition: Belonging to a group with shared culture and origin.
entries.definitionCN: 属于共享文化与来源的群体。

normalIntro.en: The contest sense grew from a word for a rush of movement, and the ancestry sense grew from a word for breed; English keeps both under one spelling.
normalIntro.cn: 比赛义从表示「急冲」的词生长出来，种族义从表示「品种」的词生长出来；英语把两者放在同一个拼写之下。

normal.en: Race as a contest and race as a category of people have different origins that happen to share one spelling.
normal.cn: 作为竞赛的 race 与作为人群类别的 race 来源不同，只是碰巧共用同一个拼写。

normal.en: A race against time is a race with no competitor but the clock.
normal.cn: race against time 是没有对手、只与时钟赛跑的比赛。

normal.en: Racer, racing and racial all come from the same short word with different endings.
normal.cn: racer、racing、racial 都是同一个短词加上不同词尾。

normal.en: A mill race is water rushing through a channel, which shows how old the sense of a rush really is.
normal.cn: mill race 指冲过渠道的水，可见「急冲」这一古老意思有多深。

normal.en: The human race uses race in the broad sense of all people together, not in the sense of a category.
normal.cn: the human race 用的是「全人类」这一宽泛义，而不是「某一类别」义。

abstract.en: Sorting people into races says more about the sorter than about the people being sorted.
abstract.cn: 把人分成种族，更多说明分类者本身，而不是被分类的人。

abstract.en: A race is exciting because everyone agrees on the same finish line, which is also why disagreements about the line are so bitter.
abstract.cn: 比赛令人兴奋，因为大家认同同一条终点线，这也正是关于终点线的分歧如此激烈的原因。

abstract.en: Speed is easy to measure and easy to admire, which is why so much of modern life is arranged as a race.
abstract.cn: 速度容易测量，也容易赞美，所以现代生活有很大一部分被安排成一场比赛。

examples.en: She came second in the school race.
examples.cn: 她在学校赛跑中得了第二。

examples.en: The two companies are in a race to launch first.
examples.cn: 两家公司在争抢谁先发布。

examples.en: He raced down the stairs when he heard the alarm.
examples.cn: 听到警报，他飞奔下楼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「锐丝」——像一根锐利的丝线划过终点，速度极快，记住 race 是赛跑、竞赛。

root: 比赛义源于古诺斯语 ras（奔跑、急冲）；种族义经法语与意大利语来自 razza（品种，来源不确定）；两词在英语中同形。同族有 racer、racing、racial。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a rush; one branch runs from rush to contest, the other from breed to ancestry, and a third survives in the channel of a mill.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「急冲」；一条支线从急冲走到竞赛，另一条从品种走到血统，还有一条留在磨坊的水道里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: runners leaving the start line together on an evening track.
core.cn: 核心意象：傍晚跑道上同时冲出起跑线的选手。

branches.en: a gun fired beside a track
branches.cn: 跑道旁打响的发令枪

branches.en: two firms chasing one contract
branches.cn: 两家公司争抢同一份合同

branches.en: a form asking for ancestry
branches.cn: 要求填写血统的表格

branches.en: feet taking the stairs three at a time
branches.cn: 一步三级地冲下楼梯

branches.en: the same rush, once on legs and once in a mill channel
branches.cn: 同一种急冲，一次靠双腿，一次在磨坊渠道里

intro.en: The contest word is native and northern, the ancestry word came through French and Italian, and English adds its usual endings to both.
intro.cn: 表示竞赛的词是本族词，来自北方；表示血统的词经法语和意大利语传来；英语给两者加上了惯用的词尾。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin source is recorded for either word.
latinIntro.cn: 这两个来源都没有可靠的拉丁语出处记录。

definition_zh: 种族的；种族间的；按种族划分的
definition_en: connected with a group of people regarded as sharing ancestry; happening between such groups; based on grouping people in that way
core_image: 一张表格上并排列着几个用来勾选族群的方框
scene: 会议室里摊着一份调查报告，讨论的是不同族群在招聘中受到的待遇。The report called for an end to racial discrimination in hiring.
sceneCN: 这里 racial 是「种族的」（第 1 个义项：与按血统划分的人群有关的）；句意为这份报告呼吁终止招聘中的种族歧视。画面里可留意：摊开的报告、并排的勾选框、沉默的与会者。

pos.zh: 种族的；种族间的；按种族划分的

derivatives.zh: racial 的词根名词，指按血统划分的人群类别
race 加 -ism，指种族歧视与种族主义
race 加 -ist，指带种族歧视态度的
racial 加 -ly，指从种族角度、按种族地

senses.title: Connected with a group by ancestry
senses.definition: relating to a group of people who are regarded as sharing ancestry and physical features
senses.definitionCN: 与被视为共享血统与外貌特征的一群人有关的
senses.example: The law forbids racial discrimination in hiring.
senses.exampleCN: 法律禁止招聘中的种族歧视。
senses.why: The adjective simply adds a relating suffix to the noun race, and the noun itself came from a word for breed.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只是在名词 race 后加了表示「相关」的后缀，而那个名词本身来自表示「品种」的词。

senses.title: Happening between such groups
senses.definition: existing or occurring between different groups of people
senses.definitionCN: 存在于不同人群之间或发生在他们之间的
senses.example: Racial tension rose sharply after the election.
senses.exampleCN: 选举之后，族群之间的紧张关系急剧上升。
senses.why: Once the adjective described a group, it could also describe what happens when two such groups meet.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词既能描述一个群体，也就能描述两个这样的群体相遇时发生的事。

senses.title: Based on grouping by ancestry
senses.definition: organized or collected according to categories of ancestry
senses.definitionCN: 按照血统类别来组织或收集的
senses.example: The census collects racial data alongside age and income.
senses.exampleCN: 人口普查在收集年龄与收入数据的同时，也收集种族数据。
senses.why: Bureaucracies count people in categories, and a category built on ancestry is described as racial.
senses.whyCN: 行政机构按类别清点人口，而以血统划分的类别就被形容为 racial。

intro.en: Racial is the noun race with the Latin-derived ending -ial; the noun itself came into English through French and Italian from a word of uncertain origin meaning breed.
intro.cn: racial 是名词 race 加上源自拉丁语的词尾 -ial；那个名词本身经法语和意大利语进入英语，来自一个来源不确定、意为「品种」的词。

items.en: Razza meant a breed or a kind, especially of animals, and its own origin is uncertain.
items.cn: razza 意为品种或种类，尤指动物的品种，它本身的来源也不确定。

items.en: French race carried the sense of breed and stock, and English borrowed it in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 法语 race 带有「品种、血统」的意思，英语在十六世纪借入。

items.en: English race extended the breed sense to groups of people, a use that later became the subject of scientific debate.
items.cn: 英语的 race 把「品种」义扩展到人群，这一用法后来成为科学争论的对象。

items.en: The ending -ial, from Latin adjective endings, forms words meaning relating to.
items.cn: 词尾 -ial 来自拉丁语形容词词尾，构成意为「与……有关的」词。

items.en: Modern English uses racial for what concerns such groups and for what happens between them.
items.cn: 现代英语用 racial 指与此类群体有关的事，以及发生在它们之间的事。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the noun; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives about peoples and cultures.
note.cn: 形近组收由该名词构成的形式；近义组收表示人群与文化的形容词。

entries.definition: A group regarded as sharing ancestry.
entries.definitionCN: 被视为共享血统的一群人。

entries.definition: Prejudice or unfair treatment based on a group.
entries.definitionCN: 基于所属群体的偏见或不公对待。

entries.definition: Showing prejudice against another group.
entries.definitionCN: 对另一群体表现出偏见的。

entries.definition: A person who competes for speed, from the other race.
entries.definitionCN: 参加竞速的人，来自另一个同形的 race。

entries.definition: Relating to a group with shared culture and origin.
entries.definitionCN: 与共享文化和来源的群体有关的。

entries.definition: Relating to a whole country or people.
entries.definitionCN: 与整个国家或民族有关的。

entries.definition: Relating to shared customs and arts.
entries.definitionCN: 与共同习俗和艺术有关的。

entries.definition: Relating to a tribe or tribes.
entries.definitionCN: 与部落有关的。

normalIntro.en: The word is simply race turned into an adjective, so it describes anything done or counted by categories of ancestry.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词就是 race 变来的形容词，因此描述任何按血统类别来做或来清点的事情。

normal.en: Racial is race plus -ial, and -ial is the ending that makes a noun into an adjective of relation.
normal.cn: racial 就是 race 加 -ial，而 -ial 正是把名词变成关系形容词的词尾。

normal.en: Racism is the belief or practice, racial is what relates to groups, and racist describes a person or act.
normal.cn: racism 是信念或做法，racial 指与群体相关的，racist 形容人或行为。

normal.en: Racially is the adverb, as in racially mixed schools.
normal.cn: racially 是副词，如 racially mixed schools（种族混合的学校）。

normal.en: Racial profiling names the practice of suspecting people because of their group.
normal.cn: racial profiling 指因所属群体而怀疑某人的做法。

normal.en: The word has no comparative form because it does not admit degrees.
normal.cn: 这个词没有比较级，因为它不表示程度。

abstract.en: A category becomes an adjective, and the adjective then shapes how people are seen before they are met.
abstract.cn: 一个类别变成了形容词，而这个形容词又在你见到人之前塑造了你如何看待他们。

abstract.en: Words like racial record a way of sorting, and sorting is never only descriptive.
abstract.cn: racial 这样的词记录了一种分类方式，而分类从来不只是描述性的。

abstract.en: Calling something racial can describe a fact and also issue a judgement, depending on the sentence around it.
abstract.cn: 把某事称作 racial，既可能在描述事实，也可能在作出判断，取决于它所在的句子。

examples.en: The school has a clear policy against racial abuse.
examples.cn: 这所学校有明确的规定反对种族侮辱。

examples.en: They collected racial data for the study.
examples.cn: 他们为这项研究收集了种族数据。

examples.en: Racial equality remains a goal rather than a fact in many places.
examples.cn: 在许多地方，种族平等仍是目标而非事实。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「锐秀」——把人群锐利地分门别类，正好提醒你 racial 是种族的。

root: 意大利语 razza（品种，来源不确定）→ 法语 race（品种、血统）→ 英语 race + -ial → racial；同族有 racism、racist、racially。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a category of ancestry; the senses divide into what belongs to one group, what happens between groups, and what is organized by such categories.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「按血统划分的类别」；义项分为属于某一群体的、发生在群体之间的，以及按这类类别组织的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a form with several boxes for ancestry placed side by side.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张表格上并排放着的几个血统勾选框。

branches.cn: 招聘表上一栏留给族群的空格

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin source is recorded for the noun race itself.

definition_en: a bat for ball games, a loud noise, or an illegal money-making scheme
core_image: 一只球拍放在桌上，窗外传来一阵让人皱眉的喧哗
scene: 楼下有人开始练鼓，整栋楼都被那阵喧闹震得发慌。Someone started practising drums downstairs and the whole building shook with the racket.
sceneCN: 这里 racket 指喧闹声（第 1 个义项：吵闹的声响）；句意为楼下有人开始练鼓，整栋楼都被那阵喧闹震得发慌。

喧闹的；破旧的

senses.title: A tennis racket
senses.definition: a bat with a netted face used in ball games
senses.definitionCN: 球类运动中带网面的拍子
senses.example: She kept her racket in the car so she could play after work.
senses.exampleCN: 她把球拍放在车里，下班后就能去打。
senses.why: The concrete sense is the oldest and the most physical.
senses.whyCN: 具体义项最古老，也最物理。

senses.title: The racket of traffic
senses.definition: a loud, confused noise that goes on and on
senses.definitionCN: 持续不断、混杂的响亮声响
senses.example: Someone started practising drums downstairs and the whole building shook with the racket.
senses.exampleCN: 楼下有人开始练鼓，整栋楼都被那阵喧闹震得发慌。
senses.why: The word judges the noise as excessive, not merely loud.
senses.whyCN: 这个词判定这声响过分，而不只是响。

senses.title: A protection racket
senses.definition: an illegal business that sells safety it also threatens
senses.definitionCN: 既威胁安全又出售安全的非法生意
senses.example: The shop owners paid a protection racket for years.
senses.exampleCN: 店主们多年来向一个收取保护费的团伙交钱。
senses.why: The criminal sense grew from the idea of a noisy disturbance.
senses.whyCN: 犯罪义项从「吵闹骚扰」的意思长出来。

senses.title: A racket of complaints
senses.definition: a chorus of protest from many voices at once
senses.definitionCN: 许多声音同时发出的抗议
senses.example: The new timetable raised a racket of complaints from parents.
senses.exampleCN: 新时间表引来了家长们一片抱怨声。
senses.why: The word can describe a human chorus, not only machines.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以描述人声的合唱，不只是机器。

senses.title: To racket about
senses.definition: to move around making noise and disturbance
senses.definitionCN: 四处走动、发出噪音与骚扰
senses.example: The children racketed through the house until dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在屋里闹到天黑。
senses.why: The verb keeps the noise as an activity.
senses.whyCN: 动词把噪音当作一种活动。

senses.title: A numbers racket
senses.definition: an illegal lottery or betting operation
senses.definitionCN: 非法的彩票或赌博经营
senses.example: The numbers racket ran out of a barbershop.
senses.exampleCN: 那个地下彩票勾当就在一家理发店里运作。
senses.why: This is the organised-crime sense in its classic form.
senses.whyCN: 这是有组织犯罪义项的经典形态。

senses.title: A rackety old car
senses.definition: a machine that is noisy and in poor condition
senses.definitionCN: 吵闹且状况不佳的机器
senses.example: They toured the coast in a rackety old car.
senses.exampleCN: 他们开着一辆破旧吵闹的老车沿海岸旅行。
senses.why: The adjective extends the noise to the object itself.
senses.whyCN: 形容词把噪音延伸到了物件本身。

senses.title: Versus noise
senses.definition: a din that is judged excessive and annoying, as opposed to any sound
senses.definitionCN: 被判定为过分而恼人的喧闹，与任何声音相对
senses.example: Noise can be measured; a racket is complained about.
senses.exampleCN: noise 可以被测量，racket 会被投诉。
senses.why: The pair separates a physical event from a social judgement.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把物理事件与社会评判分开。

intro.en: Racket has two histories: the bat probably comes from French raquette, while the noise may be imitative.
intro.cn: racket 有两条历史：球拍大概来自法语 raquette，喧闹义则可能是拟声的。

items.en: The bat came through French from an Arabic root.
items.cn: 球拍经法语来自一个阿拉伯词根。

items.en: The din sense probably echoes the sound itself.
items.cn: 喧闹义很可能是对声音本身的模仿。

items.en: London slang turned a disturbance into an extortion scheme.
items.cn: 伦敦俚语把骚扰变成敲诈勾当。

items.en: Lawn tennis fixed the bat as the main sense.
items.cn: 草地网球把球拍固定为主要义项。

items.en: Today the word covers sport, noise and crime at once.
items.cn: 今天这个词同时覆盖运动、噪音与犯罪。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rack- family; the near-meaning group separates din, clamour, commotion and racketeering.
note.cn: 形近组是 rack 词族；近义组把「喧闹」「嘈杂」「骚动」「敲诈」分开。

entries.definition: an alternative spelling of the bat.
entries.definitionCN: 球拍的另一种拼法。

entries.definition: a vehicle driven by thrust.
entries.definitionCN: 靠推力飞行的飞行器。

entries.definition: a frame for storing things.
entries.definitionCN: 存放物品的架子。

entries.definition: noisy and badly worn.
entries.definitionCN: 喧闹且破旧的。

entries.definition: a loud unpleasant noise.
entries.definitionCN: 响亮难听的声音。

entries.definition: loud confused shouting.
entries.definitionCN: 响亮混乱的喊叫。

entries.definition: noisy disturbance.
entries.definitionCN: 喧闹的骚动。

entries.definition: running an illegal business.
entries.definitionCN: 经营非法生意。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep both pictures: a bat on a table and a noise coming through the floor.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想同时留住两幅画面：桌上的球拍，和从地板传来的响声。

normal.en: Racket covers bat and noise: one object, one disturbance.
normal.cn: racket 兼指球拍与噪音：一件东西，一种骚扰。

normal.en: Picture a tennis racket on a table while drums shake the floor.
normal.cn: 想象桌上放着一只网球拍，鼓声震着地板。

normal.en: Say RAK-it; it sounds short and hard, like a slap.
normal.cn: 读 RAK-it，听起来短而硬，像一记拍打。

normal.en: The criminal sense came from the noise of harassment.
normal.cn: 犯罪义项来自骚扰的噪音。

normal.en: Ask which racket is meant: sport, sound or scheme?
normal.cn: 问清是哪种 racket：运动、声音，还是勾当？

abstract.en: A racket is noise with a purpose when someone is being shaken down.
abstract.cn: 当有人被敲诈时，喧闹就带上了目的。

abstract.en: The word joins the tool and the disturbance: both are things you swing.
abstract.cn: 这个词把工具与骚扰连在一起：两者都是可以挥动的东西。

abstract.en: Every racket needs an audience, whether a crowd or a victim.
abstract.cn: 每个 racket 都需要观众，无论是一群人还是一名受害者。

examples.en: She kept her racket in the car so she could play after work.
examples.cn: 她把球拍放在车里，下班后就能去打。

examples.en: The shop owners paid a protection racket for years.
examples.cn: 店主们多年来向一个收取保护费的团伙交钱。

examples.en: The new timetable raised a racket of complaints from parents.
examples.cn: 新时间表引来了家长们一片抱怨声。

dict_mnemonic.text: racket 一物两义：手上挥的拍子，和耳边炸开的吵闹。

root: 法语 raquette（球拍）；喧闹义可能为拟声

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses swing between object and noise: a bat, a din, a criminal scheme, a chorus, the act of making noise, a lottery, a broken car and the contrast with plain noise.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项在物件与声响之间摆动：球拍、喧闹、犯罪勾当、一片人声、吵闹的动作、地下彩票、破车，以及与单纯噪音的对照。

core.en: A BAT AND A DIN
core.cn: 一只球拍与一阵喧哗

branches.en: The sporting object itself.
branches.cn: 运动物件本身。

branches.en: Noise from machines and noise from people.
branches.cn: 机器的噪音与人的噪音。

branches.en: Criminal schemes small and organised.
branches.cn: 零散与有组织的犯罪勾当。

branches.en: The verb that keeps the noise in motion.
branches.cn: 让噪音保持在动作里的动词。

branches.en: A broken noisy object and the line to plain noise.
branches.cn: 破旧吵闹的物件以及与单纯噪音的界线。

intro.cn: racket 词族扩展到犯罪与质地：racketeer、racketeering、rackety 都从同一个喧闹的词长出来。

latinIntro.en: French raquette gives the bat, possibly from Arabic rakdat, 'palm of the hand'; the noise sense has no settled root.
latinIntro.cn: 法语 raquette 提供球拍义，可能来自阿拉伯语 rakdat（手掌）；喧闹义没有确定的词根。

definition_zh: 雷达；雷达设备；洞察力
definition_en: a system that uses radio waves to detect objects and measure their position; the equipment used for this; an ability to notice things quickly
core_image: 绿色屏幕上缓慢移动的一个亮点，边缘带着淡淡的余辉
scene: 值班室里，绿色屏幕上出现一个缓慢移动的亮点，值班员记下方位和距离。The tiny blip on the radar was a fishing boat lost in the fog.
sceneCN: 这里 radar 是「雷达」（第 1 个义项：用无线电波探测物体位置的系统）；句意为雷达上那个小小的光点是一艘在雾中迷失的渔船。画面里可留意：绿色屏幕、移动的亮点、记录方位的手。

pos.zh: 雷达；雷达设备；洞察力

collocations.zh: 在雷达上；在关注范围内

derivatives.zh: radar 与 scope 复合，指雷达显示器
radar 与 man 复合，指操作雷达的人员
radar 与 dome 缩合，指保护雷达天线的罩壳

senses.title: A radio detection system
senses.definition: a system that sends out radio waves and reads the echoes to find objects and their positions
senses.definitionCN: 发出无线电波并读取回声，以发现物体及其位置的系统
senses.example: The plane appeared on radar at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 正午时分，那架飞机出现在雷达上。
senses.why: The word is an acronym built from radio detection and ranging, so the name describes exactly what the system does.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是由「无线电探测与测距」的首字母拼成的缩略词，名字正好描述了该系统所做的事。

senses.title: The equipment itself
senses.definition: the set of apparatus that produces and receives the radio waves
senses.definitionCN: 产生并接收无线电波的一整套设备
senses.example: The ship's radar failed in the fog.
senses.exampleCN: 那艘船的雷达在雾中失灵了。
senses.why: Once the system had a name, the physical set that contains it took the same name, as happens with many devices.
senses.whyCN: 这套系统有了名字之后，装着它的实体设备也叫同一个名字，许多器械都是如此。

senses.title: A knack for noticing things
senses.definition: an informal ability to sense or notice things that others miss
senses.definitionCN: 一种察觉他人忽略之事的非正式能力
senses.example: She has a radar for insincerity.
senses.exampleCN: 她对虚情假意有一种敏锐的直觉。
senses.why: A device that detects what the eye cannot see became a metaphor for a person who notices what others miss.
senses.whyCN: 一种能察觉肉眼看不见之物的人造装置，成了「能注意到他人忽略之事的人」的比喻。

intro.en: Radar is a twentieth-century acronym, not an inherited word; it was coined from the initials of radio detection and ranging.
intro.cn: radar 是二十世纪的缩略词，不是继承下来的词；它由「无线电探测与测距」的首字母拼成。

items.en: Radio waves could be bounced off objects, and the returning echo carried information about distance and direction.
items.cn: 无线电波可以从物体上反弹，返回的回声携带着距离与方向的信息。

items.en: Ranging meant measuring distance, and the time an echo takes gives the distance of the object that reflected it.
items.cn: ranging 意为测距，回声所用的时间可以给出反射它的物体的距离。

items.en: The initials of the phrase were joined into one pronounceable word during the nineteen forties.
items.cn: 这个短语的首字母在二十世纪四十年代被拼成一个可读的词。

items.en: The device was developed for detecting aircraft and ships, and the short name made it easy to say in a hurry.
items.cn: 这种装置为探测飞机与船只而发展起来，简短的名字让人在匆忙中也容易说出口。

items.en: Modern English uses radar for the device, for the technique and, figuratively, for a person's alertness.
items.cn: 现代英语用 radar 指设备、技术，也比喻一个人的警觉。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers compounds built on the acronym; the near-meaning group gathers words for detection and sensing.
note.cn: 形近组收由这个缩略词构成的复合词；近义组收表示探测与感知的词。

entries.definition: The screen that displays radar returns.
entries.definitionCN: 显示雷达回波的屏幕。

entries.definition: A person who operates radar equipment.
entries.definitionCN: 操作雷达设备的人。

entries.definition: A cover that protects a radar antenna.
entries.definitionCN: 保护雷达天线的罩壳。

entries.definition: The technology of sending signals by electromagnetic waves.
entries.definitionCN: 用电磁波传送信号的技术，radar 的前半部分即由此而来。

entries.definition: The act of discovering something that is present.
entries.definitionCN: 发现某物存在的行为。

entries.definition: Following the movement of something over time.
entries.definitionCN: 随时间追踪某物的运动。

entries.definition: A device that responds to something in its surroundings.
entries.definitionCN: 对周围事物作出反应的装置。

entries.definition: A system that detects objects under water by sound.
entries.definitionCN: 用水下声波探测物体的系统。

normalIntro.en: The name is an acronym, so its five letters carry the whole method: send radio waves, hear the echo, measure the time.
normalIntro.cn: 名字本身就是缩略词，五个字母承载了整套方法：发出无线电波、听回声、算时间。

normal.en: Radar is radio detection and ranging shortened to its initials, which is why the word has no ordinary root.
normal.cn: radar 是 radio detection and ranging 的首字母缩写，所以它没有平常意义上的词根。

normal.en: On the radar means being noticed or watched, taken from the glowing blip on a screen.
normal.cn: on the radar 指被注意或被关注，来自屏幕上发亮的光点。

normal.en: Under the radar means going unnoticed, as a plane that does not show up on the screen.
normal.cn: under the radar 指不被注意，像一架不在屏幕上显示的飞机。

normal.en: Sonar is the underwater cousin: sound navigation and ranging, built the same acronym way.
normal.cn: sonar 是它水下的亲戚：声呐导航与测距，同样用缩略法造出。

normal.en: A radar for insincerity is a metaphor: the person detects what others fail to see.
normal.cn: a radar for insincerity 是比喻：这个人能察觉别人看不见的东西。

abstract.en: Radar taught the modern world to trust what cannot be seen, as long as a machine reports it.
abstract.cn: 雷达教会现代世界去相信看不见的东西，只要有一台机器报告它。

abstract.en: The same word now names a device and a human gift, because both mean noticing what is out of sight.
abstract.cn: 同一个词现在既指装置也指人的天赋，因为两者都意味着察觉视线之外的东西。

abstract.en: Every detection system defines what counts as a signal, and that definition is a human choice inside a machine.
abstract.cn: 每一套探测系统都要界定什么算作信号，而这个界定是机器内部的人为选择。

examples.en: The storm showed up on radar two hours before it arrived.
examples.cn: 暴风雨到达前两小时就在雷达上出现了。

examples.en: The coast guard uses radar to find boats in heavy fog.
examples.cn: 海岸警卫队用雷达在浓雾中寻找船只。

examples.en: He has a radar for people who are only pretending to listen.
examples.cn: 他对那些假装在听的人有一种敏锐的直觉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「雷打」——雷打一样的电波扫出去，碰到东西就弹回来，记住 radar 是雷达。

root: 二十世纪缩略词，由 radio detection and ranging（无线电探测与测距）的首字母拼成；没有拉丁语词源。同族有 radarscope、radarman、radome。

sensesIntro.en: The core is detection by echo; the senses divide into the system, the equipment and the figurative alertness of a person.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「靠回声探测」；义项分为系统本身、设备本身，以及比喻意义上人的警觉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single bright blip drifting across a green screen.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个明亮的光点在绿色屏幕上缓缓移动。

branches.en: a wave leaving an antenna and returning
branches.cn: 从天线发出又返回的一道波

branches.en: a cabinet of dials below a screen
branches.cn: 屏幕下方一排旋钮的机柜

branches.en: a host noticing a guest's false smile
branches.cn: 主人察觉到客人虚假的笑容

branches.en: the method and the box that carries it out
branches.cn: 方法与实现它的那只箱子

branches.en: the same noticing, once by a machine and once by a mind
branches.cn: 同一种察觉，一次由机器，一次由头脑

intro.en: The word is an acronym, so its parts are the initials of English technical terms rather than roots or affixes.
intro.cn: 这个词是缩略词，它的组成部分是英语技术术语的首字母，而不是词根或词缀。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source is recorded for this word, which was coined in the twentieth century.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是二十世纪新造的，没有拉丁语来源记录。

definition_zh: 辐射；散发（热、光）；流露；呈放射状散开
definition_en: to send out heat, light or feeling from a centre, or to spread outward
core_image: 一块烧红的铁把热一圈圈推向四周，越远越淡
scene: 炉子烧起来以后，热从铁皮中心一圈圈散到房间各处。Once the stove was lit, heat began to radiate from its centre across the room.
sceneCN: 这里 radiate 指散发热量（第 1 个义项：向外辐射）；句意为炉子烧起来以后，热从铁皮中心一圈圈散到房间各处。

pos.zh: 辐射；散发；流露；呈放射状散开
放射状的

derivatives.zh: 辐射；放射
散热器；暖气片
发光的；容光焕发的

senses.title: To radiate heat
senses.definition: to give off heat in all directions from a source
senses.definitionCN: 从热源向各个方向放出热量
senses.example: Once the stove was lit, heat began to radiate from its centre across the room.
senses.exampleCN: 炉子烧起来以后，热从铁皮中心一圈圈散到房间各处。
senses.why: The first sense is physical and directional.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是物理的、有方向的。

senses.title: To radiate light
senses.definition: to send out light that spreads from a point
senses.definitionCN: 从一点向四周放出的光
senses.example: The lamp radiated a soft yellow light over the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 台灯在书桌上散出柔和的黄光。
senses.why: Light and heat share the same outward motion.
senses.whyCN: 光与热共享同一种向外的运动。

senses.title: To radiate joy
senses.definition: to show a feeling so strongly that others feel it coming from you
senses.definitionCN: 强烈地表现一种情感，别人感到它从你身上发出
senses.example: She radiated joy from the moment she entered the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她一走进房间，就流露出喜悦。
senses.why: The metaphor makes a person into a source.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把一个人变成一个光源。

senses.title: To radiate confidence
senses.definition: to give others a strong impression of assurance
senses.definitionCN: 给别人强烈的可靠感
senses.example: The young speaker radiated confidence without raising his voice.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻演讲者没有提高音量，却流露出自信。
senses.why: The sense is social: a quality is transmitted outward.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是社会的：一种品质被向外传送。

senses.title: Radiating lines
senses.definition: lines that spread from a common point like spokes
senses.definitionCN: 像辐条一样从同一点散开的线
senses.example: The map showed roads radiating from the old market square.
senses.exampleCN: 地图上，道路从老市场广场呈放射状散开。
senses.why: Geometry keeps the shape and drops the energy.
senses.whyCN: 几何学保留形状，丢掉能量。

senses.title: Radiate from a centre
senses.definition: to spread outward in every direction from a single origin
senses.definitionCN: 从单一原点向各方向扩散
senses.example: Every rumour seemed to radiate from one small office.
senses.exampleCN: 所有传闻似乎都从那间小办公室散开。
senses.why: The sense can describe information as easily as warmth.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项描述信息，和描述温度一样容易。

senses.title: A radiating pattern
senses.definition: a design of lines or rays that run outward from a middle
senses.definitionCN: 由中心向外延伸的线或射线构成的图案
senses.example: The ceiling carried a radiating pattern of thin wooden strips.
senses.exampleCN: 天花板上有一种细木条构成的放射状图案。
senses.why: Design borrows the geometry of light.
senses.whyCN: 设计借用了光的几何。

senses.title: Versus emit
senses.definition: to spread in all directions, as opposed to sending out in one
senses.definitionCN: 向各方向散开，与朝一个方向发出相对
senses.example: A lamp emits light; a fire radiates warmth.
senses.exampleCN: 灯发出光，火散发热。
senses.why: The pair separates a beam from a glow.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把光束与光晕分开。

intro.en: Radiate comes from Latin radiare, 'to emit rays', from radius, a spoke or ray.
intro.cn: radiate 来自拉丁语 radiare（放出射线），词根是 radius（辐条、光线）。

items.en: Radius named a spoke of a wheel and a ray of light.
items.cn: radius 指车轮的辐条，也指光线。

items.en: Radiare meant to send out rays.
items.cn: radiare 意为放出射线。

items.en: English used radiate for light and heat first.
items.cn: 英语最初用 radiate 指光与热。

items.en: Radiation became a technical term for transmitted energy.
items.cn: radiation 成为传递能量的技术术语。

items.en: The word now also describes a person who seems to glow.
items.cn: 今天这个词也描述一个仿佛在发光的人。

note.en: The look-alike group is the radi- family; the near-meaning group separates emit, diffuse, emanate and spread.
note.cn: 形近组是 radi 词族；近义组把「发出」「扩散」「散发」「传播」分开。

entries.definition: sending out light or joy.
entries.definitionCN: 发出光或喜悦的。

entries.definition: energy sent out as rays.
entries.definitionCN: 以射线形式发出的能量。

entries.definition: a device that gives off heat.
entries.definitionCN: 散发热量的装置。

entries.definition: a line from the centre to the edge.
entries.definitionCN: 从中心到边缘的线。

entries.definition: to send out light, sound or gas.
entries.definitionCN: 发出光、声或气体。

entries.definition: to spread widely through a space.
entries.definitionCN: 在空间中广泛扩散。

entries.definition: to come out from a source.
entries.definitionCN: 从某个源头流出。

entries.definition: to extend over a wider area.
entries.definitionCN: 扩展到更大范围。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a hot iron sending warmth outward in rings.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一块烧红的铁一圈圈向外送热」的画面。

normal.en: Radiate shares its root with radius and ray: everything leaves a centre.
normal.cn: radiate 与 radius、ray 同根：一切都从中心离开。

normal.en: Picture spokes on a wheel and heat travelling along each one.
normal.cn: 想象车轮上的辐条，热沿着每一根往外走。

normal.en: Say RAY-dee-ate; the first syllable sounds like ray.
normal.cn: 读 RAY-dee-ate，第一音节听起来就是 ray。

normal.en: The word moves easily from stoves to smiles.
normal.cn: 这个词从炉子移到微笑，毫不费力。

normal.en: Ask which direction: outward from a point, or straight along a beam?
normal.cn: 问方向：是从一点向外，还是沿一条光束直走？

abstract.en: To radiate is to make your centre visible.
abstract.cn: 辐射，就是让你的中心变得可见。

abstract.en: Heat, light and feeling obey one grammar: a source, a direction, a distance.
abstract.cn: 热、光与情感遵守同一套语法：一个源、一个方向、一段距离。

abstract.en: The word flatters people: it turns a mood into a form of energy.
abstract.cn: 这个词抬举人：它把一种心境变成一种能量。

examples.en: The lamp radiated a soft yellow light over the desk.
examples.cn: 台灯在书桌上散出柔和的黄光。

examples.en: She radiated joy from the moment she entered the room.
examples.cn: 她一走进房间，就流露出喜悦。

examples.en: The map showed roads radiating from the old market square.
examples.cn: 地图上，道路从老市场广场呈放射状散开。

dict_mnemonic.text: radi（光线、辐条）+ ate（动词）→ 像辐条一样向外散。

root: 拉丁语 radius（辐条、光线）→ radiare（放出射线）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses send one motion outward: heat, light, joy, confidence, lines, rumours, ornament and the contrast with a straight beam.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把同一种运动向外送：热、光、喜悦、自信、线条、传闻、装饰，以及与直射光束的对照。

core.en: HEAT LEAVING A CENTRE
core.cn: 从中心离开的热

branches.en: Heat and light as the physical pair.
branches.cn: 作为物理一对的热与光。

branches.en: Joy and confidence felt as energy.
branches.cn: 被感受为能量的喜悦与自信。

branches.en: Geometry and design made from rays.
branches.cn: 由射线构成的几何与图案。

branches.en: Anything that spreads from one office or point.
branches.cn: 任何从一处散开的事物。

branches.en: A glow set against a beam.
branches.cn: 光晕与光束相对。

intro.en: The radi- family is built on rays: radiate, radiant, radiation, radiator and radius all start from a line leaving a centre.
intro.cn: radi 词族建立在射线上：radiate、radiant、radiation、radiator、radius 都从一条离开中心的线开始。

latinIntro.en: Latin radius gives the noun of spoke and ray, radiare the verb, and -atio the process noun that became radiation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 radius 提供辐条与射线的名词，radiare 提供动词，-atio 提供过程名词，后来成为 radiation。

derivatives.zh: 辐射
散热器
发光的

definition_zh: 辐射；放射线；辐射热；散发
definition_en: energy that travels through space as waves or particles; the rays or particles themselves; heat transferred from a warm surface; the spreading of something outward from a centre
core_image: 一圈圈从中心向外扩散的细线，像热浪在空气里散开
scene: 实验室里，仪器旁贴着黄色警示牌，工作人员穿着厚重的防护服记录读数。The meter showed a low level of radiation near the old mine.
sceneCN: 这里 radiation 是「辐射」（第 1 个义项：以波或粒子形式在空间传播的能量）；句意为仪器显示那座旧矿附近辐射水平很低。画面里可留意：黄色警示牌、厚重的防护服、跳动的读数。

pos.zh: 辐射；放射线；辐射热；散发

derivatives.zh: radiation 的动词形式，指发出辐射、从中心向外扩散
radiate 加 -or，指散发热量的暖气片或散热器
radiate 加 -ive，指与辐射有关的
同出拉丁语「射线」一词，指半径，即从中心射出的一条线

senses.title: Energy travelling as waves or particles
senses.definition: energy that moves through space in the form of waves or particles
senses.definitionCN: 以波或粒子形式在空间中传播的能量
senses.example: The sun's radiation warms the earth.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳的辐射使地球变暖。
senses.why: Latin radiare meant to emit rays, and radiation names the whole process of energy going out in rays.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 radiare 意为发出射线，radiation 指能量以射线形式向外发出的整个过程。

senses.title: The rays or particles themselves
senses.definition: the rays or particles produced by a source, considered as things in themselves
senses.definitionCN: 由某个源产生的射线或粒子，被当作事物本身来看
senses.example: Thick walls protected the workers from radiation.
senses.exampleCN: 厚墙保护工人免受放射线伤害。
senses.why: The process and its product share one noun, so the thing that travels is also called radiation.
senses.whyCN: 过程与产物共用一个名词，于是那些传播出去的东西也被称作 radiation。

senses.title: Heat given off by a warm surface
senses.definition: heat transferred from a warm object to cooler surroundings without moving air
senses.definitionCN: 热表面在不靠空气流动的情况下向较冷环境传递的热
senses.example: The radiator warms the room by radiation as well as by hot air.
senses.exampleCN: 暖气片既靠辐射也靠热空气使房间变暖。
senses.why: Physics divides heat transfer into conduction, convection and radiation, and the third name keeps the image of rays going out.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把传热分为传导、对流与辐射，第三个名称保留了「射线外发」的形象。

senses.title: A spreading outward from a centre
senses.definition: the spreading of something, such as ideas or influence, outward from a central point
senses.definitionCN: 思想或影响等从中心点向外扩散
senses.example: The radiation of new ideas across the region took decades.
senses.exampleCN: 新思想在该地区的扩散花了几十年。
senses.why: Anything that spreads outward like rays can be described with the same noun, even when nothing physical is travelling.
senses.whyCN: 任何像射线一样向外扩散的东西都能用这个名词描述，即使传播的并非实物。

intro.en: Radiation comes from a Latin verb meaning to emit rays, built on the Latin word for a spoke or a ray, and it entered English through the language of science.
intro.cn: radiation 源自一个意为「发出射线」的拉丁语动词，其基础是拉丁语表示「辐条、射线」的词，并经科学语言进入英语。

items.en: Radius meant a spoke of a wheel or a ray of light, a straight line going out from a centre.
items.cn: radius 指车轮的辐条或一束光线，是从中心射出的一条直线。

items.en: Radiare meant to send out rays or to shine, describing light leaving a source in straight lines.
items.cn: radiare 意为发出射线或发光，描述光从光源沿直线射出。

items.en: Radiatio named the act of shining or the rays sent out, and it was used for the glow of a source.
items.cn: radiatio 指发光这一行为或发出的射线，曾用来指光源的光辉。

items.en: Scientists applied the word to energy leaving a body in waves or particles, and English adopted that use.
items.cn: 科学家把这个词用于物体以波或粒子形式放出的能量，英语接受了这一用法。

items.en: Modern English uses radiation for nuclear and solar energy, for the rays themselves, for radiant heat and for any outward spread.
items.cn: 现代英语用 radiation 指核能与太阳能、射线本身、辐射热，以及任何向外扩散。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms on the Latin stem of rays; the near-meaning group gathers words for emitted energy and outflow.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语「射线」词干上的形式；近义组收表示发出的能量与外流的词。

entries.definition: To send out rays, heat or a feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 发出射线、热或某种感觉。

entries.definition: A device that gives off heat into a room.
entries.definitionCN: 向房间散发热量的装置。

entries.definition: Relating to the giving off of rays.
entries.definitionCN: 与发出射线有关的。

entries.definition: A straight line from the centre to the edge of a circle.
entries.definitionCN: 从圆心到圆周的一条直线。

entries.definition: The act of sending something out.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物发送出去的行为。

entries.definition: A narrow beam of light or energy.
entries.definitionCN: 一束狭窄的光或能量。

entries.definition: The capacity to do work or to cause change.
entries.definitionCN: 做功或引起变化的能力。

entries.definition: Radioactive particles that settle after an explosion.
entries.definitionCN: 爆炸后落下的放射性颗粒。

normalIntro.en: The word is built on the image of a spoke or a ray leaving a centre, and every sense keeps that picture of something going outward.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词建立在「从中心射出的辐条或光线」这一意象上，每个义项都保留了「向外而去」的画面。

normal.en: Radiation, radius and radiate all come from the Latin word for a ray, a line leaving a centre.
normal.cn: radiation、radius 与 radiate 都出自拉丁语表示射线的词，即从中心射出的一条线。

normal.en: A radiator heats a room by giving off rays of warmth, which is why it shares the name.
normal.cn: 暖气片靠散发热射线来温暖房间，所以它共用这个名字。

normal.en: Nuclear radiation is invisible, so people measure it with counters rather than with their senses.
normal.cn: 核辐射看不见，所以人们用计数器而不是感官来测量它。

normal.en: Radiation therapy uses controlled rays to treat illness, turning the same energy into a tool.
normal.cn: 放射治疗用受控的射线治病，把同一种能量变成工具。

normal.en: The radiation of ideas is a metaphor: nothing physical travels, but influence spreads like light.
normal.cn: 思想的扩散是比喻：没有实物在旅行，但影响像光一样传播。

abstract.en: A word built from spokes reminds us that every source sends something outward, whether heat, light or fear.
abstract.cn: 一个由辐条构成的词提醒我们：每个源头都在向外发送什么，无论是热、光还是恐惧。

abstract.en: Radiation is both a danger and a cure, and the same noun names the healer and the threat.
abstract.cn: 辐射既是危险也是治疗手段，同一个名词既指救治之物，也指威胁。

abstract.en: What spreads from a centre cannot be recalled, which is why the word carries a quiet sense of consequence.
abstract.cn: 从中心扩散出去的东西收不回来，所以这个词带着一种无声的「后果」意味。

examples.en: Thin clouds do not stop all of the sun's radiation.
examples.cn: 薄云并不能挡住太阳的全部辐射。

examples.en: Workers at the plant wear badges that measure radiation.
examples.cn: 工厂的工人佩戴测量辐射的徽章。

examples.en: The radiation of the new style reached neighbouring towns within a few years.
examples.cn: 这种新风格的扩散在几年内就传到了邻近城镇。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「锐地埃申」——锐利的东西从一点向四面射出，记住 radiation 是辐射。

root: 拉丁语 radius（辐条、射线）→ radiare（发出射线）→ radiatio（发光、射线）→ 英语 radiation；同族有 radiate、radiator、radiative、radius。

sensesIntro.en: The core is rays leaving a centre; the senses divide into the energy, the rays themselves, radiant heat and any outward spreading.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「从中心射出的线」；义项分为能量、射线本身、辐射热，以及任何向外的扩散。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fine lines spreading outward from a single point, like heat shimmering off a surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：从一个点向外散开的细线，像热浪从表面升腾。

branches.en: a sunlit stone warming in the open
branches.cn: 露天里被晒热的石头

branches.en: a badge worn to measure what cannot be seen
branches.cn: 为测量看不见之物而佩戴的徽章

branches.en: a radiator ticking as it heats a room
branches.cn: 暖气片发出轻响、温暖房间

branches.en: a style spreading from one town to the next
branches.cn: 从一座城传到下一座城的风格

branches.en: the same outward flow of heat, once from the sun and once from a pipe
branches.cn: 同一种向外的热流，一次来自太阳，一次来自管道

intro.en: The word is Latin throughout: a noun of rays, a verb of sending them out and a noun of action, with English relatives built on the same stem.
intro.cn: 这个词从头到尾都是拉丁语：表示射线的名词、表示发出射线的动词与动作名词，加上由同一词干构成的英语亲属词。

latinIntro.en: Latin radius also gave English radius, the line from the centre of a circle.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 radius 还给英语送来了 radius，即从圆心射出的一条线。

definition_zh: 根本的；彻底的；激进的；激进分子；根式
definition_en: relating to the root of a matter and therefore thorough; wanting great political or social change; a person who wants such change; a root expression in mathematics
core_image: 一棵被连根拔起的树，根须上还挂着泥土
